discription: A short, percussive bell-like sound created with slightly detuned sine waves and a quick attack/decay envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.005, 0.15, 0.0, 0.3, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = (SinOsc.ar(freq) * 0.7 + SinOsc.ar(freq * 1.008) * 0.3); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
